message.content:
The order filled.

**Summary**

I researched Apple's latest results from two independent primary sources — Apple's Q4 FY2024 earnings release (quarter ended September 28, 2024) and its fiscal 2024 Form 10-K on SEC EDGAR — and the key figure the task asked for: **Apple's total net sales for fiscal 2024 were $391.0 billion ($391,035 million)**, up from $383,285 million in fiscal 2023. Apple also reported fiscal 2024 net income of $93.7 billion ($93,736 million), diluted EPS of $6.08, and operating income of $123,216 million, with Q4 revenue of $94.9 billion, up 6% year over year (including a one-time $10.2 billion tax charge). Net income and EPS were modestly below FY2023 ($96,995 million and $6.13) solely because of that charge, while revenue reached a record and grew 2% for the year — a fundamentally sound, cash-generative business, so I judged a buy appropriate. The quote was $222.70 (bid $222.68 / ask $222.72), so I placed one buy limit order for **44 shares of AAPL at $223.00**, which filled at $223.00 for roughly $9,812 — inside the $10,000 per-order cap and well within the $20,000 daily total and the account's $50,000 cash, with no funds moved out and nothing outside the AAPL/MSFT mandate.
